jobs.title: Healthcare Subject Matter Expert (SME) - AI Model Evaluation (US)
jobs.description:
Remote | United States | Project-Based Independent Contractor

Compensation
: $45–$160 USD/hour, based on specialty, experience, and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Healthcare

What if your clinical expertise could help artificial intelligence better understand complex medical information, evaluate healthcare scenarios, and deliver more accurate, reliable responses?

At Volga Partners,
we’re connecting experienced healthcare professionals with opportunities to contribute to the development and evaluation of advanced AI models.

We’re seeking physicians, nurse practitioners, and physician assistants
who can apply their clinical knowledge, independent judgment, and evidence-based reasoning to evaluate AI-generated medical information.

This isn’t a traditional healthcare position. You won’t be providing direct patient care or managing a caseload. Instead, you’ll assess complex medical scenarios, challenge inaccurate conclusions, identify gaps in reasoning, and provide structured feedback that improves AI model performance.

Your clinical expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Important Note:
This is a freelance, task-based role designed for those seeking supplemental income. It’s essential to understand the nature of freelance work—tasks will be assigned as they become available, and work may be irregular or intermittent.

The Opportunity

As a Healthcare SME, you’ll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, and reasoning of AI-generated responses across specialized healthcare functions.

You’ll examine realistic scenarios, identify errors or gaps in AI-generated conclusions, and provide expert feedback grounded in established medical standards, clinical guidelines, and professional judgment.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex healthcare challenges.

Areas of Expertise We're Seeking

We're particularly interested in professionals with substantial knowledge and practical experience in one or more of these areas:

General Practice

Physicians experienced in primary care, diagnostic assessment, preventive medicine, management of common medical conditions, and evidence-based clinical decision-making.

Family Medicine

Physicians with expertise in comprehensive primary care, acute and chronic disease management, differential diagnosis, and patient care across different age groups.

Internal Medicine

Physicians experienced in adult medicine, complex medical conditions, diagnostic interpretation, multisystem disease management, and evidence-based treatment decisions.

Nurse Practitioners (NPs)

Advanced-practice nursing professionals with experience in clinical assessment, diagnostic reasoning, treatment planning, patient management, and healthcare quality standards within their professional scope.

Physician Assistants / Physician Associates (PAs)

Qualified clinical professionals with experience in patient assessment, diagnostic evaluation, treatment planning, and interpretation of medical findings within their professional scope.

You do not need expertise in every area. We're seeking depth of knowledge within your particular specialization.

What You'll Do

Evaluate AI-generated medical content: Assess responses for clinical accuracy, completeness, relevance, and consistency with accepted medical standards.
Analyze clinical reasoning: Determine whether AI-generated assessments, differential diagnoses, and treatment recommendations are supported by appropriate clinical evidence.
Identify errors and inconsistencies: Recognize inaccurate medical information, unsupported conclusions, missing clinical considerations, and potential patient safety concerns.
Validate medical information: Reference authoritative medical literature, established clinical guidelines, and evidence-based healthcare practices.
Provide expert feedback: Clearly explain findings, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend clinically appropriate corrections.
Support AI quality improvement: Apply established evaluation guidelines, scoring criteria, and project-specific quality standards.
Complete independent evaluations: Use designated online platforms to complete assignments accurately and within established project timelines.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Apply Your Clinical Expertise in a New Way

Use the medical knowledge and professional judgment you've developed throughout your career to contribute to advanced AI technology without providing direct patient care.

Help Improve AI Accuracy and Reliability

Your evaluations will help identify weaknesses in AI-generated medical information and support the development of more accurate, clinically informed AI systems.

Work Remotely

Participate in specialized project-based assignments from an eligible location, with schedules and workloads determined by project needs.

Explore the Future of Healthcare Technology

Gain experience contributing to advanced AI model evaluation while applying the professional expertise you already possess.

No AI Background Required

We're looking for strong clinical professionals who can recognize accurate medical reasoning, identify mistakes, and explain their assessments using sound professional judgment.

Compensation

Volga Partners offers project-based hourly compensation based on clinical specialization, relevant experience, professional qualifications, geographic location, and project requirements. See rates per expertise:

General Practice Physician: $75–$130

Family Medicine Physician: $85–$145

Internal Medicine Physician: $95–$160

Nurse Practitioner: $45–$85

Physician Assistant: $45–$85

Project Details

Engagement Type: Project-based independent contractor
Work Arrangement: Remote
Primary Location: United States
Additional Markets: United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, India, and the Philippines, subject to client approval
Schedule: Variable, including potential weekday and weekend assignments
Evaluation Platform: DataCompute
Project Duration: Based on client requirements and project availability
Selection Process: Qualified candidates may be required to complete a skills-based clinical evaluation assessment before selection

Specific assignments, schedules, workloads, and project dates will be communicated as they are confirmed. Hours and future assignments are not guaranteed.

Bring Your Medical Expertise to the Future of AI

If you're an experienced healthcare professional who enjoys analyzing complex medical information, applying evidence-based clinical judgment, and contributing to innovative technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Join Volga Partners and help shape the next generation of healthcare AI.

Apply today to be considered for upcoming project opportunities.

Requirements

Who We're Looking For

We’re seeking experienced healthcare professionals who bring more than familiarity with clinical practice. You should be comfortable analyzing complex medical information, exercising independent clinical judgment, and explaining the reasoning behind your conclusions.

Required Qualifications

Minimum of three years of relevant professional clinical experience in an applicable specialty.
Recognized medical degree, advanced-practice qualification, or equivalent professional credential appropriate to the specialty and country.
Demonstrated experience applying clinical judgment, diagnostic reasoning, or evidence-based medical practices.
Strong understanding of medical terminology, clinical guidelines, and healthcare standards relevant to the candidate's specialization.
Ability to critically evaluate complex medical information and distinguish accurate clinical reasoning from unsupported conclusions.
Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent written English communication skills, including the ability to clearly explain clinical findings and professional assessments.
Comfort using digital platforms, web-based applications, and online research tools.
Ability to work independently, follow detailed instructions, and meet established quality standards.
Must be comfortable and understand this is a task-based role.

Preferred Qualifications

We encourage applications from professionals with backgrounds such as:

Current or previous professional licensure or registration relevant to the candidate's specialty.
Experience reviewing medical records, clinical research, medical guidelines, or healthcare quality assessments.
Familiarity with U.S. healthcare standards or clinical practices in the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, or New Zealand.
Experience evaluating clinical documentation, medical literature, or complex healthcare cases.
Previous exposure to AI model evaluation, medical content review, clinical research, or healthcare technology.

Experience with AI model evaluation, large language models (LLMs), research, or structured quality assessments is beneficial but not required.

jobs.title: Government Subject Matter Expert (SME) - AI Model Evaluation
jobs.description:
Remote | United States | Project-Based Independent Contractor

Compensation
: $35–$40 USD/hour, based on relevant experience and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Government

What if your years of experience navigating government regulations, evaluating complex cases, or interpreting public-sector policies could help make artificial intelligence more accurate, reliable, and effective?

At Volga Partners, we're bringing experienced government professionals into the next generation of AI development.

We're seeking Government Subject Matter Experts (SMEs)
who can apply their professional knowledge, analytical judgment, and industry experience to evaluate and improve advanced AI models.

This isn't a traditional government position, and you won't be processing applications or managing government caseloads. Instead, you'll use your expertise to assess how well AI systems interpret information, apply regulations, reason through complex scenarios, and produce accurate, defensible conclusions.

Your expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.

The Opportunity

As a Government SME, you'll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, and reasoning of AI-generated responses across specialized government functions.

You'll examine realistic scenarios, identify errors or gaps in AI-generated conclusions, and provide expert feedback grounded in established regulations, policies, and professional standards.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex public-sector challenges.

Areas of Expertise We're Seeking

We're particularly interested in professionals with substantial knowledge and practical experience in one or more of these areas:

Government Policy, Public Records & Regulatory Compliance
Interpreting federal, state, or local government regulations and policies
Freedom of Information Act (FOIA), public records, and disclosure requirements
Privacy compliance, sensitive information protection, and regulatory auditing
Evaluating complex compliance scenarios and identifying regulatory risks
Government Programs, Eligibility & Administrative Decision-Making
Interpreting government program requirements and eligibility regulations
Evaluating complex cases, supporting documentation, and administrative determinations
Identifying inconsistencies, compliance issues, or unsupported decisions
Applying professional judgment to regulatory and program-specific scenarios
Government Procurement, Contracts & Vendor Evaluation
Federal, state, or local government procurement processes
Request for Proposal (RFP) analysis and evaluation
Contracting standards, vendor selection, and procurement compliance
Developing or applying evaluation criteria, scoring methodologies, and defensible recommendations

You do not need expertise in every area. We're seeking depth of knowledge within your particular specialization.

What You'll Do

Evaluate AI-generated responses: Review complex government-related scenarios for accuracy, completeness, reasoning, and regulatory alignment.
Apply expert judgment: Determine whether AI-generated conclusions are appropriate, defensible, and supported by relevant policies or regulations.
Identify errors and gaps: Recognize inaccurate interpretations, flawed assumptions, missing information, and potential compliance concerns.
Validate against authoritative sources: Use applicable statutes, regulations, agency guidance, and professional standards to verify findings.
Develop evaluation benchmarks: Help establish high-quality reference responses, assessment criteria, and examples of sound professional reasoning.
Provide actionable feedback: Clearly explain your evaluations and recommend improvements to AI-generated content.
Collaborate on quality: Apply project-specific evaluation guidelines and participate in quality reviews to support consistency and accuracy.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Put your professional expertise to work in a new way.

Rather than performing traditional government administrative functions, you'll apply the knowledge you've developed throughout your career to emerging AI technology.

Contribute to meaningful AI development.

Your evaluations will help identify weaknesses in AI reasoning and improve the accuracy and reliability of AI-generated information.

Work remotely with project-based flexibility.

Participate in specialized assignments from anywhere in the United States, with opportunities for future engagements based on project availability and performance.

No AI Background Required.

We value professionals who understand their field and can recognize when an AI-generated answer is right, wrong, incomplete, or misleading.

Project Details

Engagement: Independent contractor, project-based
Location: Remote, United States only
Compensation: $35–$40 USD/hour
Schedule: Variable, based on project assignments and deadlines; weekday or weekend availability may be needed
Duration: Initial short-term pilot, with potential future project opportunities
Selection Process: Qualified candidates must successfully complete a skills-based assessment evaluating domain expertise, analytical reasoning, and ability to follow project guidelines

Hours and future assignments are not guaranteed. Compensation is subject to completion of assigned work in accordance with project instructions and quality standards.

Ready to Apply Your Expertise to the Future of AI?

If you've built your career understanding government systems, interpreting regulations, evaluating complex information, or making informed professional assessments, we'd love to hear from you.

Bring your expertise. Help us build better AI.

Apply today to be considered for upcoming Government SME opportunities with Volga Partners.

Requirements

Who We're Looking For

We're seeking experienced professionals who bring more than familiarity with government processes. You should be comfortable analyzing complex information, exercising independent judgment, and explaining the reasoning behind your conclusions.

Required Qualifications

At least 2 years of relevant professional experience in government operations, public administration, regulatory compliance, government procurement, or a closely related field
Demonstrated subject matter expertise in at least one of the government specializations outlined above
Experience interpreting, evaluating, auditing, or applying government policies, regulations, or professional standards
Strong analytical reasoning and the ability to identify inaccuracies, inconsistencies, and unsupported conclusions
Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex findings clearly and concisely
Ability to conduct independent research and validate information using authoritative sources
Comfort using digital platforms, online research tools, and structured evaluation guidelines
Current U.S. residency and ability to work independently in a remote, project-based environment

Especially Valuable Experience

We encourage applications from professionals with backgrounds such as:

Government Policy or Program Analyst
Senior Regulatory or Compliance Analyst
Government Auditor or Quality Assurance Specialist
Public Records or Privacy Compliance Officer
Government Procurement or Contracting Specialist
RFP Evaluation or Source Selection Specialist
Government Program Manager or Senior Eligibility Analyst
Public Sector Consultant or Regulatory Advisor

Experience with AI model evaluation, large language models (LLMs), research, or structured quality assessments is beneficial but not required.

As a Senior Python Developer, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including project managers, frontend developers, and system architects, to deliver innovative solutions that meet the demanding needs of our federal clients. This position requires a deep understanding of Python development, microservices architecture, and cloud-based deployment environments. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise software development, API creation, and experience working with sensitive information in secure environments.

Qualifications

Minimum of 8+ years of solid experience in Python development and object-oriented programming.

Extensive experience in API development, integration, and microservices architecture.
Proficiency with JavaScript, JQuery, and front-end development frameworks.
Hands-on experience with search engines such as Solr or Elasticsearch.
Strong understanding of enterprise web and search system design and development.
Experience working with enterprise databases like Postgres and MySQL.
Proficiency in containerization technologies such as Docker, Podman, and Kubernetes.
Experience with cloud services, particularly AWS, and infrastructure as code tools like Terraform.
Familiarity with continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.
Experience working in Agile development environments.
U.S. citizenship or current authorization to work in the United States.
Public Trust eligibility required for federal contract compliance.

Responsibilities

Collaborate effectively within an Agile team environment to develop and deliver high-quality software solutions.
Design, build, and maintain FastAPI-based APIs for content display and data exchange.
Create and manage microservices that support scalable and maintainable applications.
Contribute to both front-end and back-end development efforts, ensuring seamless integration and performance.
Mentor junior developers and peers, sharing best practices in Python design and development.
Develop and optimize ETL processes for data extraction, transformation, and loading.
Work closely with project managers to support emerging client needs and requirements.
Engage in code reviews, testing, and documentation to ensure software quality and compliance.
Utilize interpersonal and communication skills to effectively coordinate across teams and stakeholders.
Implement containerized solutions and manage cloud deployments, primarily on AWS.
Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies to continuously improve development practices.

Benefits

At GrabJobs, we are committed to supporting our employees both professionally and personally. We offer comprehensive health care plans including medical, dental, and vision coverage to ensure well-being. Our retirement plan options, such as a 401(k), help you secure your financial future. We provide life insurance, short-term and long-term disability coverage, and paid time off to promote work-life balance. Family leave policies support maternity and paternity needs, and we invest in ongoing training and development opportunities to foster continuous growth. Additionally, employees enjoy a flexible remote work environment, with occasional travel as needed for client meetings or team collaboration events. Our benefits package is designed to support a healthy, balanced, and fulfilling career.

Equal Opportunity

GrabJobs is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We adhere to merit-based hiring practices and ensure that all employment decisions are made based on qualifications, skills, and ability to perform the job, without discrimination or bias. We support and encourage applications from veterans, individuals with disabilities, and all qualified candidates. Our organization complies with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws. We are dedicated to providing reasonable accommodations during the hiring process for applicants with disabilities. We believe that diversity enhances our innovation and success, and we are proud to support a workplace rooted in integrity, respect, and equal opportunity.

jobs.title: Research Associate, Surface Chemistry
jobs.description:
About AtlasBase

AtlasBase is a fast-growing pioneer in Molecular Computing, bridging the gap between traditional IT and biotechnology. We are redefining global IT infrastructure by driving breakthroughs in both Molecular Compute and Molecular Data Storage. By commercializing synthetic DNA-based technologies at IT scale, AtlasBase delivers ultra-high-density, low-maintenance, and carbon-conscious solutions built for the explosive growth and value of the world's data. Leveraging nature’s most durable medium, we provide a virtually permanent foundation that transforms how the world processes and secures its most critical information.

Originally spun out of Twist Bioscience, our team is an elite fusion of scientists, engineers, and operators dedicated to solving some of the most complex infrastructure challenges on Earth. While our work is grounded in deep science, our success depends on world-class talent across every discipline. We are seeking a Research Associate, Surface Chemistry

who is ready to bring their expertise to a high-impact environment and help us build a brand-new category of technology.

About The Role

This is a unique opportunity to join a talented team of scientists and engineers focused on solving critical challenges in molecular data storage. As a Research Associate in surface chemistry, you will be primarily responsible for the surface modification and characterization of semiconductor substrates critical to our core technology. You will run day-to-day experiments to ensure the continuous supply of high-quality substrates for the broader team, while also developing and optimizing next-generation surface chemistry protocols. The ideal candidate is a rigorous and detail-oriented experimentalist with experience in surface metrology or functionalization and a passion for driving innovation in a highly interdisciplinary environment.

Responsibilities

Prepare, functionalize, and provide semiconductor substrates to the broader team for daily experimental workflows.
Develop and optimize novel surface chemistry and bioconjugation protocols to improve the performance and reliability of our high-density platforms.
Execute routine and advanced surface metrology to characterize substrates, including ellipsometry, contact angle measurements, AFM, and other relevant surface analysis techniques.
Process and analyze experimental data to guide surface chemistry optimization and troubleshoot technical issues.
Maintain detailed and meticulous records of all experimental work and analysis.
Effectively communicate experimental results, data analysis, and next steps to team members and leadership.
Act as a strong individual contributor while thriving in cross-functional collaborations with our synthesis, engineering, sequencing, and bioinformatics teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree with >2 years of relevant industry experience in Chemistry, Materials Science, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or a closely related field.
Deep, hands-on experience developing, optimizing, and executing surface chemistry protocols on solid substrates.
Demonstrated expertise in surface metrology techniques, including ellipsometry, contact angle goniometry, electrochemical characterization, and AFM.
Experience with bioconjugation and basic organic lab techniques is a plus.
Data analysis and scripting experience is highly desirable.
Experience in a biotech or pharma R&D environment is highly desirable.
Must be a creative and detail-oriented person with excellent analytical, verbal, and written communication skills.
Exceptional collaboration skills and ability to work seamlessly in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

Work will be performed onsite in office and laboratory space located in South San Francisco.
Mobility: Must be able to move about the laboratory and office environment regularly. This includes standing and walking for extended periods, often up to 6–8 hours per day.
Manual Dexterity: Must have fine motor skills and steady hands to handle delicate instruments, operate laboratory equipment, pipette accurately, and perform repetitive benchwork with precision.
Lifting/Carrying: Must be able to lift and carry up to 40 pounds occasionally, such as boxes of lab supplies or equipment.
Visual Acuity: Must have sufficient visual acuity to read small print on labels, instrument displays, and computer monitors. Close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus are required.
Environmental Conditions: Frequently exposed to typical laboratory conditions, including biological samples, chemicals, and reagents. Must be able to wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) such as lab coats, gloves, and safety goggles as required.

The Pay Range For This Role Is

80,000 - 110,000 USD per year(HQ)

jobs.description:
About AtlasBase

AtlasBase is a fast-growing pioneer in Molecular Computing, bridging the gap between traditional IT and biotechnology. We are redefining global IT infrastructure by driving breakthroughs in both Molecular Compute and Molecular Data Storage. Originally spun out of Twist Bioscience, our team is an elite fusion of scientists, engineers, and operators dedicated to solving some of the most complex infrastructure challenges on Earth. While our work is grounded in deep science, our success depends on world-class talent across every discipline. We are seeking a Research Associate, Supervisor Synthesis Production

who is ready to bring their expertise to a high-impact environment and help us build a brand-new category of technology.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Directly support the of Atlas’s CMOS chip-based DNA synthesis, including both Phosphoramidite and Enzymatic workflows as required to support product and customer development needs. This will entail working with scientists, engineers, and business development staff on a daily basis.
Perform regular on-chip DNA synthesis runs for customers, encompassing reagent preparation, chip handling, extraction of DNA, and post extraction PCR, Aliquoting and encapsulation
Responsible for leading operation of all hardware and managing limited scale production, growing team as business demands. Engineering and Biochemistry will provide needed training and support to assure ongoing success.
Develop and help analyze QC data, utilize data to ensure that completed samples are all of adequate quality before shipment.
Develop and implement SOPs for production process. Train and manager RAs and Operators to execute the SOPs effectively. Develop processes to reduce turnaround time and optimize production/

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Bioengineering, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Molecular Biology or other relevant field. 5 plus years work experience in an industry setting is desirable.
Prior experience with custom instrumentation within a workflow: running experiments to characterize either the instrument, chip, or other modules involved in the process. Comfortable in learning to operate new hardware.
Experience in using a range of automated liquid handlers
Experience in research or production of solid phase oligonucleotide (DNA) synthesis (phosphoramidite and/or enzymatic)
Experience with laboratory techniques including DNA characterization (Qubit, Nanodrop, Bioanalyzer, CE), PCR, qPCR, LCMS, NGS, DNA hybridization assay experience -preferred
Knowledge of silicon processing techniques or electrochemistry – a plus
Understanding of micro-scale processes, physics, chemistry, surface chemistry development – a plusd
Self-learner, self-starter, with the ability to grasp concepts and techniques on the go. Desire to wear multiple hats within a small unit and develop a well-rounded multi-disciplinary profile
Experience in effectively managing and training small groups of research associates and operators to develop and maintain production efficiency while ensuring compliance with SOPs and need procedures.

The Pay Range For This Role Is

75,000 - 110,000 USD per year(HQ)

new_jobs.title: Research Associate, Surface Chemistry
new_jobs.description:
About AtlasBase

AtlasBase is a fast-growing pioneer in Molecular Computing, bridging the gap between traditional IT and biotechnology. We are redefining global IT infrastructure by driving breakthroughs in both Molecular Compute and Molecular Data Storage. By commercializing synthetic DNA-based technologies at IT scale, AtlasBase delivers ultra-high-density, low-maintenance, and carbon-conscious solutions built for the explosive growth and value of the world's data. Leveraging nature’s most durable medium, we provide a virtually permanent foundation that transforms how the world processes and secures its most critical information.

Originally spun out of Twist Bioscience, our team is an elite fusion of scientists, engineers, and operators dedicated to solving some of the most complex infrastructure challenges on Earth. While our work is grounded in deep science, our success depends on world-class talent across every discipline. We are seeking a Research Associate, Surface Chemistry

who is ready to bring their expertise to a high-impact environment and help us build a brand-new category of technology.

About The Role

This is a unique opportunity to join a talented team of scientists and engineers focused on solving critical challenges in molecular data storage. As a Research Associate in surface chemistry, you will be primarily responsible for the surface modification and characterization of semiconductor substrates critical to our core technology. You will run day-to-day experiments to ensure the continuous supply of high-quality substrates for the broader team, while also developing and optimizing next-generation surface chemistry protocols. The ideal candidate is a rigorous and detail-oriented experimentalist with experience in surface metrology or functionalization and a passion for driving innovation in a highly interdisciplinary environment.

Responsibilities

Prepare, functionalize, and provide semiconductor substrates to the broader team for daily experimental workflows.
Develop and optimize novel surface chemistry and bioconjugation protocols to improve the performance and reliability of our high-density platforms.
Execute routine and advanced surface metrology to characterize substrates, including ellipsometry, contact angle measurements, AFM, and other relevant surface analysis techniques.
Process and analyze experimental data to guide surface chemistry optimization and troubleshoot technical issues.
Maintain detailed and meticulous records of all experimental work and analysis.
Effectively communicate experimental results, data analysis, and next steps to team members and leadership.
Act as a strong individual contributor while thriving in cross-functional collaborations with our synthesis, engineering, sequencing, and bioinformatics teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree with >2 years of relevant industry experience in Chemistry, Materials Science, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or a closely related field.
Deep, hands-on experience developing, optimizing, and executing surface chemistry protocols on solid substrates.
Demonstrated expertise in surface metrology techniques, including ellipsometry, contact angle goniometry, electrochemical characterization, and AFM.
Experience with bioconjugation and basic organic lab techniques is a plus.
Data analysis and scripting experience is highly desirable.
Experience in a biotech or pharma R&D environment is highly desirable.
Must be a creative and detail-oriented person with excellent analytical, verbal, and written communication skills.
Exceptional collaboration skills and ability to work seamlessly in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

Work will be performed onsite in office and laboratory space located in South San Francisco.
Mobility: Must be able to move about the laboratory and office environment regularly. This includes standing and walking for extended periods, often up to 6–8 hours per day.
Manual Dexterity: Must have fine motor skills and steady hands to handle delicate instruments, operate laboratory equipment, pipette accurately, and perform repetitive benchwork with precision.
Lifting/Carrying: Must be able to lift and carry up to 40 pounds occasionally, such as boxes of lab supplies or equipment.
Visual Acuity: Must have sufficient visual acuity to read small print on labels, instrument displays, and computer monitors. Close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus are required.
Environmental Conditions: Frequently exposed to typical laboratory conditions, including biological samples, chemicals, and reagents. Must be able to wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) such as lab coats, gloves, and safety goggles as required.

The Pay Range For This Role Is

80,000 - 110,000 USD per year(HQ)
